Title: Auth screens both color schemes
Steps: 1. View /login /signup /forgot-password in light. 2. Toggle to dark. 3. Compare vs concept images.
Expected Result: All text/inputs visible in both schemes; no stuck-black chrome; matches concepts
Evidence: PASS: with `user-theme-preference=light` the auth screens render light chrome - <html> has no dark class and the covering surfaces are rgb(242,242,242) / rgb(244,241,235); with `dark` the class is applied and the surfaces are rgb(1,1,1) / rgb(12,12,14). Login + signup captured in both schemes (output/qa/AUTH10-{login,signup}-{light,dark}.png).
Notes: The app default preference is Dark (DEFAULT_SETTINGS_STATE), so a fresh profile shows dark until Appearance is changed - not a defect, but QA must set the preference before a light-mode capture (media emulation alone does nothing).
